00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000025.title: Mara learns to doubt
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000025.synopsis: Mara begins trusting measurements over memories and ends able to leave a coastline blank because she is not sure of it.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000025.notes: Her arc is the prologue rule, kept and broken in the same gesture.
